summary: NES Remix entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: NES Remix
entries.definitive_edition: NES Remix Pack is the best physical Wii U access route because it bundles NES Remix and NES Remix 2.

emulation.emulator: Wii U hardware or compatible Wii U emulator for owned software
emulation.notes: Use Wii U for the complete original challenge set; 3DS Ultimate is a secondary-only portable variant.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Wii U presentation using emulated NES game excerpts.

primary.version: NES Remix, preferably via NES Remix Pack retail disc or previously owned eShop copy
primary.why: NES Remix is a Wii U game built around 204 challenges from 16 NES titles. The full Wii U version remains the complete route; Ultimate NES Remix on 3DS is a selective compilation rather than the full first game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Wii U with NES Remix Pack or a previously purchased eShop copy. The Wii U/3DS eShops are closed for new purchases, so physical NES Remix Pack is the cleanest current acquisition path when available.

secondary.exclusive_content: Ultimate NES Remix includes 3DS-only Speed Mario Bros. and Famicom Remix modes while selecting challenges from the Wii U games.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only the 3DS-only modes and any selected portable challenge variants after the full Wii U route.
secondary.why: Ultimate NES Remix is not the full Wii U game, but it has source-backed exclusive modes worth a secondary pass for completion.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wii U and 3DS eShop purchases ended March 27, 2023, and online/Miiverse-era features are sunset; redownload is limited to existing owners per Nintendo support.

entries.title: NES Remix 2
entries.definitive_edition: NES Remix Pack is the best physical Wii U access route because it bundles NES Remix and NES Remix 2.

emulation.emulator: Wii U hardware or compatible Wii U emulator for owned software
emulation.notes: Use the Wii U version for the full challenge set and Super Luigi Bros.; use 3DS Ultimate only for its unique portable modes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Wii U presentation using emulated NES game excerpts.

primary.version: NES Remix 2, preferably via NES Remix Pack retail disc or previously owned eShop copy
primary.why: NES Remix 2 is a Wii U release with 169 challenges from 12 additional NES titles, plus Super Luigi Bros. and Championship Mode when the first NES Remix is also present. The 3DS Ultimate release is selective and has unique portable modes, so it is secondary rather than the main route.
primary.how_to_play: Use NES Remix Pack on Wii U, or an owned Wii U eShop copy of NES Remix 2 with NES Remix available for Championship Mode. Then sample Ultimate NES Remix on 3DS for its unique modes only.

secondary.exclusive_content: Ultimate NES Remix has Speed Mario Bros. and Famicom Remix modes while selecting challenges from both Wii U games.
secondary.what_to_play: Play Speed Mario Bros., Famicom Remix, and any 3DS-specific portable challenge presentation after the Wii U main route.
secondary.why: The 3DS release is not the complete Wii U sequel but has source-backed exclusive modes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wii U and 3DS eShop purchases ended March 27, 2023; online/Miiverse-era functionality is also sunset, so treat leaderboards/community features as historical.

entries.title: Ultimate NES Remix

emulation.notes: Use Nintendo 3DS or 2DS hardware for normal play; preservation capture should keep the dual-screen UI readable.

primary.why: Ultimate NES Remix is the handheld 3DS compilation, exclusive to Nintendo 3DS and 2DS, separate from the Wii U releases in the wider NES Remix series.
primary.how_to_play: Use a Nintendo 3DS or 2DS with the physical game card, or a previously purchased download since new 3DS eShop purchases ended in 2023.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Nintendo 3DS eShop no longer sells new purchases; use a physical card or prior download. Do not substitute NES Remix Pack, which is a different Wii U package.
